messages.en:
Sometimes, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}
you find yourself a little
strapped for cash.
It's no big deal. I mean,
it happens to everyone
sometimes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Well let me tell you, if you
need some pocket change
fast, here's a little tip.
{07 14 00}Collect shells on the beach!
You can sell them for some
quick money, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Vahel, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}
avastad sa, et sul on
pisut rahapuudus.
Pole hullu. Ma mõtlen,
seda juhtub kõigiga
vahel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Noh, las ma ütlen sulle, kui
sul on kiiresti taskuraha
vaja, siis siin on vihje.
{07 14 00}Korja rannalt karpe!
Sa võid neid müüa ja saada
kiiret raha, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I like to take a nice
walk on the beach in the
morning, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Some mornings, it's so nice
and peaceful that you can
hear just about anything.
{07 0d 00}Sometimes, I think I hear
the sound of the Earth
revolving, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib teha kena
jalutuskäik rannas
hommikul, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Mõnel hommikul on nii kena
ja rahulik, et sa võid
kuulda peaaegu kõike.
{07 0d 00}Vahel arvan ma, et kuulen
Maa pöörlemise
häält, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is just about the best
time to take a walk out
on the beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}After an especially busy
morning,{01 00 00 05 00} it's nice to spend
your day out on the beach.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on umbes parim
aeg minna rannas
jalutama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Pärast eriti kiiret
hommikut{01 00 00 05 00} on kena veeta
päev rannas.

messages.en:
I've been spending a lot of
time at the beach lately,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}It's nice to be out by
yourself at night on the
beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Nobody comes around to
bother you,{01 00 00 05 00} and you can sit
alone with your thoughts.
messages.et:
Ma olen viimasel ajal palju
aega rannas veetnud,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}On kena olla öösel
rannas omaette,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Keegi ei tule sind
tülitama,{01 00 00 05 00} ja sa võid istuda
üksi oma mõtetega.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The ocean is so dark this
late at night. I feel like it
might swallow me whole!
{07 13 00}It's almost too beautiful.
It's almost a little bit
frightening, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ookean on nii pime nii
hilisel ööl. Mul on tunne, et
see võib mu alla neelata!
{07 13 00}See on peaaegu liiga ilus.
See on peaaegu pisut
hirmutav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 03 00}Wrong-o!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Sorry, but {ff 00 00 07}coral{ff 00 00 00}
is the wrong answer!

Looks like you've still got
a lot to learn about the
sea, {04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 03 00}Vale!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Vabandust, aga {ff 00 00 07}korall{ff 00 00 00}
on vale vastus!

Paistab, et sul on veel
palju mere kohta
õppida, {04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Ding ding ding! We have a
winner, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}And you know what? {ff 00 00 07}White
scallops{ff 00 00 00} are just about the
hardest shells to find!
{07 06 00}I've been trying to get
enough to make a necklace
for ages now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Ding ding ding! Meil on
võitja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}Ja tead mida? {ff 00 00 07}Valged
kammkarbid{ff 00 00 00} on umbes kõige
raskemini leitavad karbid!
{07 06 00}Ma olen juba ammu üritanud
saada piisavalt kaelakee
tegemiseks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Oooo, {01 00 00 0a 00}sorry!{01 00 00 0f 00} You were
close, but {ff 00 00 07}{07 16 00}conch {ff 00 00 00}is the
wrong answer, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}To tell you the truth, I
wish they were worth more.
{ff 00 00 07}Conchs {ff 00 00 00}are my favorites.
{07 13 00}When you hold them up to
your ear,{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 09 00} you can hear the
wind echoing in your head.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ooo, {01 00 00 0a 00}vabandust!{01 00 00 0f 00} Sa olid
lähedal, aga {ff 00 00 07}{07 16 00}tõrikodalane {ff 00 00 00}on
vale vastus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ausalt öeldes soovin ma,
et need oleksid kallimad.
{ff 00 00 07}Need {ff 00 00 00}on mu lemmikud.
{07 13 00}Kui sa hoiad neid kõrva
ääres,{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 09 00} kuuled sa tuule
kaja oma peas.
